pageHeadHtml:
Disclosures

Funding, advisory roles, and consultancy relevant to my AI and healthcare research.
pageBodyHtml:
Funding

Principal Investigator or Ashoka lead on several competitively funded clinical AI programmes; two Gates Foundation-supported programmes (~US$1.36 million combined) as Clinical/Technical Team Supervisor. Full detail with sources: Grants & Funding.

Advisory, consultancy & research partnerships

  • Qure.ai — clinical validation / product feedback (chest-radiograph and clinical AI validation).
  • Manentia AI — clinical AI collaborator / product evaluation (CXR reporting pipelines; PREDICT-AI consortium).
  • Radiogram — clinical workflow and structured-reporting collaboration.
  • Tata Memorial Hospital — research partner (PREDICT-AI, oncology clinical decision support).
  • Microsoft Research India — research collaboration (clinical AI evaluation / ambient AI).
  • Google — research-support programme (Gemini Academic Program, ~US$20,000 in cloud/model support for CRASH Lab).
  • OpenAI — research-support programme (research credits/access for lab members, ~US$15,000).
  • Locum radiologist, Medanta and Fortis Hospitals, Dec 2024–Jan 2025.

Equity

None.

Honoraria

None beyond standard conference/institutional speaker arrangements listed on the Talks page.
